meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后,当你要修 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时,Claude 会在临时环境复现问题、写失败测试、做最小修复并验证;再按归属交付:LazyCodex 仓库开带补丁的 issue,不开 PR;openai/codex 用 fork 开 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、贡献 bug 修复,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷并提 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下 lazycodex 的某个 bug,先复现再给最小补丁。
say.note: 它会在临时工作区复现、修复并验证。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 能修吗?我想贡献一个 PR。
say.note: 如属上游,它会 fork 仓库并创建 PR。

say.text: 为 lazycodex 的打包 bug 准备一份带补丁的 issue。
say.note: 该仓库只发 issue,不开 PR。

howto.what_en: When asked to fix a LazyCodex/Codex bug, Claude reproduces it in a temp clone, adds a failing test, applies the smallest fix, and delivers a patch issue for LazyCodex-owned repos or a fork PR for upstream Codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this lazycodex bug: reproduce first, then give a minimal patch.
say_en.note: It reproduces, fixes, and verifies in a temp workspace.

say_en.text: Can you fix this Codex CLI bug and open a PR?
say_en.note: It will fork openai/codex and create the PR.

say_en.text: Write a verified-fix issue with a patch for this lazycodex packaging bug.
say_en.note: It delivers an issue, never a PR, for that repo.
